content:
Tally marks, pictographs with scales, bar graphs and the mean-median-mode trio — Class 6 data handling rewards careful reading of keys and scales. Here is what the IMO Class 6 data handling chapter tests, with a free 10-question test with charts.

What the Class 6 Maths Olympiad Data Handling chapter tests

  • Tally marks and frequency
  • Pictographs with symbol keys (including half-symbols)
  • Bar graphs and scales
  • Mean, median, mode, range and simple probability

Key facts your child should know

  • Tally bundles group in FIVES — the fifth stroke crosses the four.
  • Multiply symbols by the KEY: 8 symbols × 5 students = 40.
  • Mean = sum ÷ count; median = middle after ORDERING; mode = most frequent.
  • Probability of a head on a fair coin = 1/2.

Common mistakes to avoid

  • Ignoring the key and counting symbols as ones.
  • Forgetting to order the data before taking the median.
  • Reading a bar against the wrong scale gridline.

Take the free Data Handling test (IMO Class 6)

The 10-question quiz below is drawn from our verified IMO Class 6 question bank. Read each question, pick an answer, then check your score for instant explanations. Want more? The Data Handling Chapter Worksheets e-book has 100 MCQs in 10 worksheets, colourful diagrams with the questions, and full solutions — the ideal Maths Olympiad for Class 6 worksheets PDF with answers.

questions.q: A die is rolled. What is the probability of getting an even number?

faq.a: Order them (48, 56, 60, 72, 84) — the middle value is 60.

faq.q: What does a half symbol mean in a pictograph?
faq.a: Half the key value — if one symbol = 100 books, a half symbol is 50.
